Name: Rose's Shop Expansion with Plus Keep First Year Prices patch included
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
Hello, everyone! I'm back with a new mod that I've been wanting to create for a few weeks now. This is a shop expansion mod that adds a variety of items to the in-game shop, allowing you to buy even more useful items. With this mod, you can purchase items that are typically hard to obtain in the game, though at a premium price. This means you'll have more flexibility when managing resources and planning your next move. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, having access to a wider selection can change how you approach challenges in the game.

In addition to expanding the selection, this mod is designed to make your gameplay experience smoother by giving you access to rare materials without endless searching. You'll find tools, materials, and other valuable items that help you level up faster and explore more of the game's content. The mod ensures that you can keep progressing even if you run into tough spots that require specific resources. It also introduces a new economic aspect where strategic buying decisions can impact your overall gameplay. For those who love customization and variety, this mod provides a new way to tailor your experience and maximize your in-game potential. Enjoy a new layer of strategy as you decide which items are worth the investment!

I highly recommending using this mod with the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28955]Searchable Shops"[/url] Mod. This mod adds many items to the shops and this mod will make it easier to find them. [b]Also, Please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]

[Update 1/14/2025: I added an addon that keeps the first year prices. You can use it by itself or use it with the Shop Expansion Mod. Its Your choice :)]
